# Fonts for the generated placeholder art

Unaltered copies from the [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) repository. Only
`tools/gen_placeholders.py` reads them; the game loads the bitmap sheets it writes into
`data/placeholder/`, never these files.

| Font | File | License | Source (google/fonts commit) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Luckiest Guy | `luckiest-guy/LuckiestGuy-Regular.ttf` | Apache 2.0 (`luckiest-guy/LICENSE.txt`) | `apache/luckiestguy/`, `9a93667` |
| Arimo | `arimo/Arimo[wght].ttf` | SIL OFL 1.1, no Reserved Font Name (`arimo/OFL.txt`) | `ofl/arimo/`, `d7b3b07` |

Downloaded 2026-10-15.
